utfall: Risikodifferanse for langvarig sykefravær eller uførepensjon 20–29 år ved psykisk belastning i ungdommen, justert for demografi og familie (2,6 etter justering for frafall)
sitat: The risk differences adjusted for demography and family variables for somatic disease, psychological distress or poor health versus no health problem were respectively 5.4% (95% CI 3.5 to 7.3), 3.8% (CI 1.3 to 6.4) and 7.7% (CI 5.1 to 10.4).
